data.name: Anand
data.gender_notes: Anand is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ānanda, 'bliss, joy, happiness'. Its root is Sanskrit ānand (आनन्द्). A central concept in Vedanta philosophy. Anand is a Sanskrit name meaning “Bliss; joy; happiness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anand expresses “Bliss; joy; happiness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ānanda, 'bliss, joy, happiness'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anand total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
